propositions: A rejected tickets-branch auto-push succeeds locally and reports success to the caller while the push is silently rejected, leaving commits unpushed and unshared for hours without surfacing the reason or backlog size.

The _NON_FF regex misclassifies policy declines (hook declined, push protection) as retriable non-fast-forwards, discarding stderr and skipping the reason-bearing log call while burning futile retries.
PUSH_PENDING is computed only during fsck (pull-only path) and never re-announced on write, so a growing unpushed backlog reads as identical one-shot warnings across 122 commits.
Ticket event payloads containing raw credentials or secrets are never scanned on write; only code-review patches are gated by gitleaks, leaving comments unprotected.

Three independent failure surfaces prevent push rejection warnings from reaching the writing agent: async detached push with stderr=DEVNULL, NullHandler in library mode, and MCP result field omission.
